narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='m1'/>The line reaches thirty eight degrees in June, so the rise is thirty eight degrees.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>Thirty eight tells us the height of the dot, not how far it climbed.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>The climb also needs the height where the line started.
